record.question: According to the Inverse Square Law if you double your distance:
options: the intensity is reduced by four
the intensity is increased by four
there is no change in intensity as it is not dependant
the intensity is increased by two
record.explanation: Answer A: the intensity is reduced by four. By the inverse-square law, doubling source distance reduces intensity to one quarter. Reference: https://www.nist.gov/pml/periodic-table-elements; https://aerb.gov.in/english/radiation-protection-principle. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
